events.description: Carol Willick says Ross Geller should come in.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller has brought all the books.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller sends her love and has sent a lasagna.
Carol Willick asks whether the lasagna is vegetarian.
Carol Willick says Susan Bunch does not eat meat.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is pretty sure that the lasagna is vegetarian.
Carol Willick says Carol Willick has gotten the amniocentesis results today.
Ross Geller asks Carol Willick to tell Ross Geller the amniocentesis results and whether everything is okay.
Ross Geller says the healthy amniocentesis result is great.
Ross Geller asks when Carol Willick and Susan Bunch met Huey Lewis.
Carol Willick says the person in the photo is Carol Willick and Susan Bunch's friend Tanya.
Ross Geller says the person in the photo is Carol Willick and Susan Bunch's friend Tanya.
Carol Willick asks whether Ross Geller wants to know the sex of the baby Ben Geller.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is having trouble with the image of Carol Willick and Susan Bunch together, and that adding Tanya makes it harder.
Ross Geller says Carol Willick knows the sex of the baby Ben Geller.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Carol Willick should not know the sex until they look at the baby Ben Geller at birth to find out.
Susan Bunch asks whether Ross Geller has heard the amniocentesis results.
Ross Geller says everything about the amniocentesis results is A-OK.
Susan Bunch says that everything being A-OK is true.
Susan Bunch asks whether Susan Bunch and Carol Willick know the sex of the baby Ben Geller.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, who does not want to know the sex, is standing right here.
Susan Bunch asks whether the baby Ben Geller is the sex that Susan Bunch and Carol Willick thought it would be.
Ross Geller asks what Ross Geller, Carol Willick, and Susan Bunch thought the baby Ben Geller was going to be.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller should probably go now.
Susan Bunch asks whether Susan Bunch and Carol Willick should call Carol Willick's parents first or call Deb and Rona.
